name: PrettyZap
author: PrettyZap
description: Native Omarchy bar control for PrettyZap: open, hide, theme, and quit WhatsApp Web.

barWidget.description: A native bar icon with popup controls for PrettyZap visibility, settings, theme, and quit.

schema.label: Launch command
schema.description: How PrettyZap is launched when no existing D-Bus instance is available.

schema.label: Show unread as
schema.description: How unread messages appear on the bar. Count draws the numeric badge on the glyph. Highlight recolours the icon and its halo with the bar's alert colour instead, which reads at a glance without adding a second shape to a crowded bar. None leaves the icon alone.
